outfits.name: Base (swimwear)
outfits.prompt: A short young woman of Chinese-American descent with a compact, athletic build. Her rich black-brown hair is pulled up into a slightly messy high ponytail with loose tendrils framing a round face, and her warm dark brown almond-shaped eyes have an eager, earnest quality. Her skin is a warm beige with golden undertones and a faint scatter of small moles along the jawline, her nose small and straight, her lips full. She wears a bright coral sporty bikini top with medium-coverage matching coral bottoms, layered under a white half-zip short-sleeve rash guard left open at the chest so the bikini top shows beneath. A thin gold chain necklace rests at her collarbone, and a single woven friendship bracelet sits on her left wrist. Her feet are bare in black sporty sandals with secure straps. She is standing with her weight shifted onto one hip, hands clasped loosely in front of her waist, bouncing slightly on the balls of her feet, her chin tilted just slightly forward with a bright, scheming energy radiating from her posture.

outfits.name: Everyday Athleisure
outfits.prompt: A short young Chinese-American woman with a compact, athletic build and warm beige skin with golden undertones, a faint scatter of small moles along her jawline. Her rich black-brown hair is pulled up into a slightly messy high ponytail with loose tendrils framing a round, youthful face, and her eyes are warm dark brown almonds set beneath straight brows. She has a small straight nose and full lips. She wears a fitted sage-green cropped athleisure tank with a subtle racerback cut, paired with high-waisted black bike shorts that sit just above the knee, white low-top Converse sneakers laced loosely, and a thin gold chain necklace resting at her collarbone. A small dusty-pink sporty cap is clipped by its back strap to the shoulder strap of a small black crossbody bag resting against her hip. A simple leather-strap watch sits on her left wrist. She stands facing forward with her hands clasped loosely in front of her waist, bouncing almost imperceptibly on the balls of her feet, weight shifted slightly onto one leg, shoulders drawn up with a coiled, ready energy.
